attr.title: GoldenEye 007 ARM64 - Fresh Extract Test
attr.desc: Experimental R36S/PortMaster ARM64 GLES build. First launch forces ROM-derived sidecar extraction, verifies it, then launches the game.
attr.inst: Provide your own US NTSC big-endian GoldenEye 007 ROM as ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64. The package contains no ROM-derived game data; first launch generates required sidecars from your ROM.
